title: P31: RichDescription fields opaque
description: protocol-06 §7.6 RichDescription media_type, language_tag, description_content are opaque<V>. Readings: (a) validate UTF-8 / RFC 6838 / BCP 47 at decode; (b) opaque as written. Chosen: (b), implement as written; renderers validate before use. wg item filed.
